meta.name: frame-light-leak-cinema
meta.description: 胶片漏光 + 颗粒噪点 + 16:9 letterbox + 衬线大字, 电影感开场 / 章节卡

copy.tagline: 给视频添加胶片漏光与电影感字幕
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让视频片段拥有复古胶片电影的开场效果。
copy.tagline_en: Add film light leaks and cinematic subtitles to videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to give your video clips a retro film look with light leaks and letterbox.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成一张电影感单帧画面：暖色胶片漏光、35mm 颗粒噪点、16:9 或 2.39:1 宽银幕黑边，中央或左下角衬线大字标题，底部有胶片齿孔和划痕等复古细节。
howto.when: 当你要求制作电影感开场画面、章节卡或复古胶片风格图像时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一张胶片漏光的电影开场帧，标题是《末班车》。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含标题和漏光效果的 HTML 画面。

say.text: 生成一个 2.39:1 宽银幕章节卡，副标题“第三章”。
say.note: Claude 会输出带黑边和衬线字的章节画面。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude generates a cinematic single-frame image with warm film light leaks, 35mm grain, 16:9 or 2.39:1 letterbox, a large serif title centered or bottom-left, and optional film sprocket holes and scratches.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a cinematic opening frame, chapter card, or retro film-style image.

say_en.text: Create a film light-leak opening frame with the title "Last Train".
say_en.note: Claude will output an HTML frame with the title and light leaks.

say_en.text: Generate a 2.39:1 letterbox chapter card with subtitle "Chapter Three".
say_en.note: Claude will produce a widescreen chapter card with serif text.
